subject: Your 70-day legacy starts now
preview_text: You've been with us for 70 days. Here's what you're part of—and what comes next.
body_paragraphs: 70 days ago, you joined Predictify. Since then, you've seen the data, made predictions, and felt the difference between guessing and knowing. But here's the thing: you're not just a user anymore. You're part of a movement—hundreds of thousands of football fans across 14 languages, all proving that data beats gut feeling. Every prediction you've made, every streak you've built, every IQ quiz you've taken, it's all part of something bigger.

Think about it: the Premier League, La Liga, Champions League—every match has thousands of variables. Our AI crunches them all to give you confidence scores, not blind hope. You've seen how a 59% confidence call plays out. You've felt the rush of being the smartest fan in the room. That's the legacy you're building: a world where bad predictions are a thing of the past. And you're leading it.

Now, there's one feature that ties it all together: Communities. Join a fan group, vote on Prediction of the Day, and see how your insights stack up against others who share your passion. It's where your legacy becomes real—where you're not just predicting, but shaping the conversation. Open the app, find your team's community, and drop your take on today's big match.
P.S. Your Daily Streak is waiting. One tap in the app keeps it alive and unlocks free credits toward premium insights. Don't break the chain.
cta_text: Open Predictify and join your community
